responsibility: Contains the main implementation of the V850 target backend beyond the declarative machine description. It defines ABI argument passing and return-value hooks, option override logic, register/mode legality, inlining compatibility checks, operand printing and assembly helpers, prologue/epilogue and frame-related support, small-data and section state, symbolic-address and data-area handling, instruction cost and reorg hooks, and final TARGET_INITIALIZER bindings, making it the central C++ implementation file for V850 code generation behavior.
same_name_distinction: The C++ implementation file for the V850 port: unlike v850.h's macro configuration, v850.md's RTL pattern descriptions, or v850.opt's option declarations, this file contains the executable target-hook code and helper routines that implement those interfaces at runtime, including argument passing, prologue/epilogue logic, operand printing, section handling, and TARGET_INITIALIZER bindings.
